75:     def stop(self, timeout: float = 30.0) -> None:
76:         """Detiene el daemon de drenaje de forma ordenada (Apoptosis de I/O)."""
77:         with self._shutdown_lock:
78:             with self._state_lock:
79:                 self._raise_if_failed()
80:                 self._closed = True
81:                 if self._worker_thread is None:
82:                     self._start_worker()
83:                 worker = self._worker_thread
84:             if not self._sentinel_enqueued:
85:                 try:
86:                     self._queue.put(None, timeout=timeout)
87:                     self._sentinel_enqueued = True
88:                 except queue.Full as exc:
89:                     self._raise_if_failed()
90:                     raise TimeoutError("Cold ledger shutdown queue remained full") from exc
91:             if worker is not None:
92:                 worker.join(timeout=timeout)
93:                 self._raise_if_failed()
94:                 if worker.is_alive():
95:                     raise TimeoutError("Cold ledger worker did not finish draining")
96: 
97:     @property
98:     def failed_receipts(self) -> tuple[BountyClaimReceipt, ...]:
99:         """Retained failed batch for explicit recovery; not a durable acknowledgement."""
100:         with self._state_lock:
101:             return self._failed_receipts
102: 
103:     def _raise_if_failed(self) -> None:
104:         if self._failure is not None:
105:             raise BFTDatabaseError("Cold ledger persistence failed; receipts remain pending") from self._failure

50: class DisseqtTraceBufferSimulator:
51:     """
52:     Réplica EXACTA de src/disseqt_agentic_sdk/buffer/buffer.py:
53:     - Lock de threading adquirido en add_span()
54:     - Si len(buffer) >= max_batch_size, invoca _flush_locked() MIENTRAS SOSTIENE EL LOCK
55:     - self.transport.send_spans_with_failures() ejecuta HTTP POST síncrono bajo el lock
56:     """
57:     def __init__(self, max_batch_size: int = 100, max_retained: int = 1000, network_latency_sec: float = 0.005) -> None:
58:         self.lock = threading.Lock()
59:         self.buffer: List[DisseqtSpan] = []
60:         self.max_batch_size = max_batch_size
61:         self.max_retained = max_retained
62:         self.network_latency_sec = network_latency_sec # 5ms por batch (altamente optimista)
63:         self.dropped_spans = 0
64:         self.flushed_spans = 0
65: 
66:     def add_span(self, span: DisseqtSpan) -> None:
67:         with self.lock:
68:             # Drop si excede retención máxima
69:             if len(self.buffer) >= self.max_retained:
70:                 excess = len(self.buffer) - self.max_retained + 1
71:                 del self.buffer[:excess]
72:                 self.dropped_spans += excess
73:             self.buffer.append(span)
74:             # Flush bloqueante bajo el lock
75:             if len(self.buffer) >= self.max_batch_size:
76:                 # Simula la llamada HTTP POST síncrona de self.transport.send_spans_with_failures()
77:                 time.sleep(self.network_latency_sec)
78:                 self.flushed_spans += len(self.buffer)
79:                 self.buffer.clear()

120: class C5RealSovereignGate:
121:     """
122:     Barrera de ejecución de ultra-baja exergía:
123:     - Decisión determinista por Álgebra Booleana sobre entero de 64 bits.
124:     - Anillo de telemetría sin locks (Atomic Increment simulado por array estático).
125:     - Cero serialización JSON, cero asignaciones de memoria dinámicas.
126:     """
127:     def __init__(self, capacity: int = 50_000) -> None:
128:         self.capacity = capacity
129:         # Buffer de telemetría binaria compacta (16 bytes por evento: agent_id (4B), tool_id (2B), decision (2B), timestamp_us (8B))
130:         self.telemetry_buffer = bytearray(capacity * 16)
131:         self.head = 0
132:         self.lock = threading.Lock() # Lock ligero solo para emular atomic fetch_add en Python
133: 
134:     def evaluate_and_record(self, agent_id: int, agent_caps: int, required_caps: int, tool_id: int) -> bool:
135:         # 1. Decisión a nivel de bitwise CPU (< 50ns)
136:         allowed = (agent_caps & required_caps) == required_caps
137:         decision_code = 1 if allowed else 0
138: 
139:         # 2. Escritura binaria de telemetría (16 bytes fijos)
140:         with self.lock:
141:             idx = self.head % self.capacity
142:             self.head += 1
143: 
144:         offset = idx * 16
145:         # Empaqueta struct: <IHHQ (agent_id, tool_id, decision, timestamp)
146:         struct.pack_into("<IHHQ", self.telemetry_buffer, offset, agent_id, tool_id, decision_code, int(time.time() * 1e6))

22: def get_git_info(repo_path: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
23:     try:
24:         commit_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=repo_path, text=True).strip()
25:     except Exception:
26:         commit_sha = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
27: 
28:     try:
29:         branch = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"], cwd=repo_path, text=True).strip()
30:     except Exception:
31:         branch = "unknown"
32: 
33:     return {"commit_sha": commit_sha, "branch": branch}
34: 
35: def compute_repo_merkle_root(repo_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
36:     """Computes SHA-256 hashes of all tracked files in git and builds a Merkle root."""
37:     try:
38:         tracked_files = subprocess.check_output(
39:             ["git", "ls-files"], cwd=repo_path, text=True
40:         ).splitlines()
41:     except Exception:
42:         tracked_files = []
43: 
44:     file_hashes: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
45:     hasher = hashlib.sha256()
46: 
47:     for rel_path in sorted(tracked_files):
48:         full_path = os.path.join(repo_path, rel_path)
49:         if os.path.isfile(full_path):
50:             with open(full_path, "rb") as f:
51:                 content = f.read()
52:                 file_sha = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
53:                 file_hashes.append({"path": rel_path, "sha256": file_sha})
54:                 hasher.update(f"{rel_path}:{file_sha}\n".encode("utf-8"))
55: 
56:     merkle_root = hasher.hexdigest()
57:     return {
58:         "merkle_root": merkle_root,
59:         "total_files": len(file_hashes),
60:         "files": file_hashes
